data.comment:
# Comfy HappyHorse- Image to Video

Generate high-quality, fluid videos from images using HappyHorse-1.0-I2V with realistic dynamic rendering and accurate text and image semantic comprehension. Runs on Comfy Cloud and needs Comfy Cloud partner credits.

**How it works:** The Comfy nodes form the complete template graph. Run submits the graph to Comfy Cloud and saves its outputs.

**Try this:** Change the prompt or the Load node inputs and run again to compare results.

Source: https://github.com/Comfy-Org/workflow_templates/blob/1ae390968e323dba24a6991d1860ded051f5a79b/templates/api_happyhorse1_0_i2v.json (MIT). Model licenses apply separately.

data.model.prompt: The camera performs a slow, sweeping arc from left to right around the white horse as it rests serenely among the lush pink foliage, its mane gently rippling in a soft breeze. The horse shifts its head slightly, ears perking forward, while scattered white birds drift lazily through the hazy pink sky above the distant city skyline. Oversized pink ferns and blossoms sway in a gentle wind, their delicate fronds catching the diffused rose-tinted light. Cinematic, shallow depth of field, dreamlike atmosphere, 4K, soft bloom lighting, ethereal and serene mood
